name: Surronian L19 heavy freighter
description: The Surronian L19 heavy freighter was a class of transport. The smuggler Platt Okeefe suggested that pilots never buy a new L19 freighter unless they had the services of a good mechanic in her addendum added between 19 BBY and 10 BBY to the Smuggler's Guide, a journal written by Maz Kanata, owner of Takodana Castle.
